Drag a gem onto the one next to it and the two trade places. A lantern lights only the gems of its own colour that are touching it — and that colour runs on through every matching gem beside them. Line one up all the way to a sleeping critter and it wakes.

Nothing is ever used up here. Gems do not burst and do not fall — the board you are dealt is the board you finish on. So the light is not stored: it is wherever the matching gems happen to be right now. Pull a gem out of a lit line and that line goes out again.
